children: Google is rolling out its latest AI model, Gemini 4 Argon, as it continues to race with other frontier AI labs to develop increasingly capable models. The company announced Argon late last month, but said it was limiting early access to "trusted cyber defenders" due to the model's capabilities. Now, Argon, which Google says outperforms other frontier models on many benchmarks, is available for developers, enterprises, and some paid subscribers, priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens. The release comes one day after Meta Platforms released its own set of foundation models it said were at the AI frontier. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
